summary_en: BCPE Blitz Cayman, L.P. raised its tender offer price for Kakaku.com to 3,700 yen per share (or 3,720 yen if a non-subscription agreement with KDDI is concluded), up from the previously announced level. The company received this revised proposal on October 26, 2026. BCPE Blitz expects to commence its tender offer in mid-November 2026, pending satisfaction of all clearances and the company's board approval. The competing Kamgras 1 tender offer remains concurrent.
title_en: Notice Regarding Partial Change to 'Announcement of Planned Commencement of Tender Offer for Our Company Shares by BCPE Blitz Cayman, L.P.'
translation_en_brief:
On October 26, 2026, Kakaku.com received a revised proposal from BCPE Blitz Cayman, L.P. (an investment fund advised by Bain Capital Private Equity and with indirect investment by LINE Yahoo) to increase the tender offer price for the company's ordinary shares and subscription rights to 3,700 yen per share. This price can reach 3,720 yen if BCPE Blitz concludes a non-subscription agreement with KDDI Corporation.

BCPE Blitz has completed all necessary clearances required to implement the tender offer and plans to commence it in mid-November 2026, subject to the company's board expressing support and recommending participation to shareholders. The company's special committee established to review the going-private transaction has advised that the company should express its support for the BCPE Blitz offer and recommend it to shareholders. The company treats the October 26 proposal as a qualifying competing proposal under its existing agreement with Kamgras 1 and has requested to discuss the price change with Kamgras 1. The company maintains its existing position toward the concurrent Kamgras 1 tender offer while assessing which transaction better serves the company's enterprise value and shareholders' interests.
